title: The Role of Marketplace Lending in Credit Markets: Evidence from Bank Mergers
eligible_reason: The merger shock is not an absorbing staggered treatment: bankmerger = 1 only in the year a zip3 market has a branch of a large merging bank (code2_master_results.do lines 86-89), so it is a one-year pulse that can recur, and outcomes are first differences (wdif_num_branches_bm, lead1pdif_*). Table 4 adds a time-varying predicted demand_shift control (and a lagged outcome change in cols 3, 5), Tables 5-7 are 2SLS/IV with time-varying controls, Table 8 uses the kernel-matching diff command, Table 7 interacts a continuous fitted value with period. LendingClub request data (requests.dta) are not shipped.
design_notes: zip3 x year panel 2009-2016. Treatment: indicator for a large independent bank merger affecting a branch in the market in year t (non-absorbing). Table 4: xtreg FE of the winsorized change in branches on bankmerger + demand_shift + i.year (cols 2-3), weighted OLS without unit FE (cols 4-5), xtabond (col 6). Tables 5-6: xtivreg of lead changes in LC requests on wdif_num_branches_bm instrumented by bankmerger (placebo mergers in Table 6) with demand_shift small_banks pop_density branch_density and year dummies. Table 7: continuous fitted-value x period interactions. Tables 8-9: diff (kernel, rcs, bootstrap).
estimators_reported: FE regression of first differences on merger-year pulse (with controls)

specs.exclusion_reason: non-absorbing one-year merger pulse on a first-differenced outcome; time-varying control demand_shift (fitted from house price, population, income, age changes)
kernel-matching DiD (diff, kernel rcs) with controls

data_provenance_note: Branch (FDIC SOD), merger (FFIEC), demographic and credit-stress files are shipped; the LendingClub loan files behind requests.dta are withheld for privacy, so master.dta and Tables 5-9 cannot be rebuilt.
screener_notes: Design fails on treatment definition (merger-year pulse, first-differenced outcomes) independently of controls; not a near-miss. Screened from package only.
